hero.title: Sign in to BabySystem
hero.subtitle: One account, routed to the right workspace: families use User Portal, operators use Admin Portal.

card.title: Sign in
card.subtitle: Choose the authentication method that matches your account.

form.note: OTP or CAPTCHA will be enabled automatically when required.
form.twoFactorHelp: Where can I get the 2FA code?
form.setupHint: If you are signed in, this opens the QR setup page directly.

keycloak.title: Sign in with Keycloak
keycloak.description: Use SSO when your organization manages identity in Keycloak. After verification, the system exchanges it into an internal session for gateway and services.
keycloak.bullet2: No need to re-enter internal password.
keycloak.bullet3: The final session still follows BabySystem permission rules.

twoFactorModal.title: How to get 2FA code
twoFactorModal.description: The 2FA code is not generated on the login screen. You must enable 2FA first in 2FA Setup after signing in.
twoFactorModal.step1Desc: Use your internal account normally for the first sign-in.
twoFactorModal.step2: Open 2FA Setup menu or go to /2fa-setup.
twoFactorModal.step3Desc: Use Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or another compatible OTP app.
twoFactorModal.step4Desc: The OTP app generates a fresh code every 30 seconds.
twoFactorModal.step5Desc: On later sign-ins, enter the 6-digit code to complete verification.
twoFactorModal.info: If your account has not enabled 2FA, OTP is not required.

forceChangeModal.title: Change temporary password
forceChangeModal.description: Your account is using a temporary password. Set a new password to continue.
forceChangeModal.newPasswordError: New password must be at least 6 characters

messages.googleVerifyFailed: Unable to verify Google account with the system. Please try again.
messages.githubVerifyFailed: Unable to verify GitHub account with the system. Please try again.
messages.socialSuccess: Social account linked and signed in successfully!
messages.forceChangeRequiredDesc: You must change temporary password before continuing.
messages.forceChangeSuccessDesc: Password changed successfully. Signing you in...
messages.forceChangeFailed: Unable to change password. Please verify your input.
messages.forceChangeMissingContext: Missing username or temporary password. Please login again.
messages.captchaRequiredDesc: Too many wrong password attempts. Please complete CAPTCHA to continue.
messages.captchaInvalid: Invalid CAPTCHA code. Please try again.
messages.twoFactorRequiredDesc: This account has 2FA enabled. Please enter OTP from your Authenticator app.
messages.loginFailedFallback: Login failed. Please verify your account credentials.
messages.forgotPasswordSuccessDesc: A temporary password has been sent to your email. Please check your inbox.
messages.forgotPasswordFailedDesc: Unable to send password reset request. Please try again.

forgotPasswordModal.title: Forgot password
forgotPasswordModal.description: Enter your registered username or email address. The system will generate a temporary password and send it to your email address.
forgotPasswordModal.info: A temporary password will be sent to your registered email within a few seconds.

portal.userTitle: User Portal is for daily family management
portal.userDescription: This is the /app workspace for family members: baby care, meals, expenses, tasks, shopping, documents, and insights.
portal.adminTitle: Admin Portal is for system operations and control
portal.adminDescription: This is the /admin workspace for Owners/Admins: users, families, premium, finance, permissions, and APIs.
portal.userHint: For family members using the app day to day.
portal.adminHint: For administrators managing accounts, permissions, and system operations.
portal.userOutcome1: Baby care, meal plans, and tasks
portal.switchToUserHint: For family members using the app
portal.adminAccessNote: Admin accounts are granted by an Owner or administrator. Family users should return to User Portal.
